steps.what: Maintain and repair the equipment at the work site.
Record the repair when the equipment id is present.
Check the materials used on that repair.

tasks.design: The inspector maintains and repairs the materials, the work site, and the equipment. A repair is recorded in {DOCS} only when the equipment id is already known. The inspector checks the materials used. A repair with no equipment id is not filed, and the record does not do the repair.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repairs were done and the note was written later, often without the equipment number.
tasks.enabler_now: A repair that already names an equipment id can be recorded once.
tasks.still_hard: A fault the record does not describe, and a part that is not in the materials list.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a recorded repair that did not fix the equipment.
tasks.altitude: A numbered repair can be recorded once. The inspector still maintains and repairs the equipment and still checks the materials. An unnumbered repair stays in the notebook.

reach.task: Record a repair against an equipment id after the repair is done.
reach.learn: The record can be filed. The repair stays here.

evidence.claim: A repair note with an equipment id can be filed once. It cannot maintain or repair the equipment.
The site visit, the sample, and the interview stay with the inspector. A stored reading is not a finding. A label is not a sample.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Equipment id, produced by the equipment register. A repair with no equipment id is not filed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the equipment register the organisation already keeps.
research_questions: What share of equipment already has an id?
Which repairs are always done by the inspector?

already_counted.description: The inspector still maintains and repairs the equipment.
The inspector still checks the materials.

incremental.description: The inspector identifies equipment the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is filing a repair that already has an equipment id. It disappears when the id is missing and the inspector writes the note by hand. Maintaining and repairing the equipment stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare sewer charges and capacity fees.

steps.what: Calculate sewer service charges from a published rate id.
Review a capacity fee the rate table did not cover.
Store the accepted sewer charge data.

tasks.design: Sewer service charges and capacity fees are calculated in the {ERP} only when the volume id and the published rate id are both present. The inspector reviews the lines the rate table did not cover. The accepted charge data is stored only after that review. A missing rate stops the line, and the calculation does not invent a fee.
tasks.previous_blocker: Charges were prepared from a copied rate sheet, and a capacity fee from another year was reused.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored volume and a published rate can be calculated before the inspector looks at the exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: A volume with no rate, and a capacity fee the table does not contain.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a correct product of volume and rate that is not the fee this connection should pay.

ambition.what: A stored volume is priced from the published rate in the same week, when both ids exist, instead of waiting for a monthly extract.

tasks.altitude: Known volumes show a charge before the inspector looks at exceptions. The inspector still reviews what the table did not cover. Nothing is stored before that review.

reach.role: Tax Examiners and Collectors, and Revenue Agents
reach.task: Prepare a charge from a stored base and a published rate, and review the line the rate does not cover.
reach.learn: The arithmetic can be prepared. The exception stays here.

evidence.claim: A sewer charge can be calculated from a stored volume and a published rate. A missing rate cannot be filled in.
A charge is calculated only from a volume id and a published rate id. A missing rate stops the line. The desk does not invent a fee.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Volume id and rate id, produced by the meter record and the published rate table. A volume with no rate id is not calculated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the rate table the billing system already keeps.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the inspector.
unknowns: Who bills the accepted charge file.
research_questions: What share of volumes have a published rate id?
Which capacity fees are always set by hand?

already_counted.description: The inspector still reviews the fees the rate table did not cover.

incremental.description: The inspector prices a volume the rate table did not hold.

approvals.approved_version: charge version and the rate ids the calculation cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the calculation where the volume and the published rate are already stored. It disappears when the rate id is missing and the inspector prices the line. The exception review stays with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector still maintains the equipment. A published sewer rate can be applied to a stored volume before anyone checks the exceptions, and a missing rate is not given a number.
reach: Tax examiners prepare a charge from a stored base and a published rate, and this job learns the exception stays with the person.
Logistics engineers record a repair against an equipment id, and this job learns the repair itself stays on the site.
skills_to_grow: Stop a sewer charge when the published rate id is missing.
Keep equipment repair with the inspector.
role.ambitious_version: Stored volumes meet published rates before the inspector looks at the exceptions, and the equipment is still maintained by that person.
